t4.descripcion:
🔹 COMPOUND PREPOSITIONS:

• en medio de = in the middle of (en medio de la plaza)
• en el centro de = in the center of (en el centro de la ciudad)
• en la esquina de = on the corner of (en la esquina de la calle)
• al fondo de = at the back of (al fondo del pasillo)
• a la entrada de = at the entrance of (a la entrada del parque)
• a la salida de = at the exit of (a la salida del metro)
• alrededor de = around (alrededor de la mesa)
• junto a = next to (junto a la ventana)
• enfrente de = opposite (enfrente del supermercado)
• frente a = facing (frente al mar)

🔹 USEFUL EXPRESSIONS:

• a la derecha de = to the right of
• a la izquierda de = to the left of
• arriba de = above (arriba del armario)
• abajo de = below (abajo del puente)
• dentro de = inside (dentro de la caja)
• fuera de = outside (fuera del edificio)

📌 EXAMPLES:
• Hay una fuente en medio de la plaza.
• El banco está a la derecha del supermercado.
• Mi casa está al fondo del pasillo.
• Estación de metro está a la salida del parque.

📌 MIND MAP OF PREPOSITIONS:

        ARRIBA
           |
   IZQUIERDA --- DERECHA
           |
        ABAJO

• Delante = frente
• Detrás = espalda
ejemplos: Hay una fuente en medio de la plaza.
El banco está a la derecha del supermercado.
Mi casa está al fondo del pasillo.

t3.descripcion:
🔹 TO ASK (to ask):

• ¿Dónde está...? = Where is...?
• ¿Cómo llego a...? = How do I get to...?
• ¿Hay un banco por aquí? = Is there a bank around here?
• ¿Está lejos? = Is it far?
• ¿A qué distancia está? = How far is it?
• ¿Cuánto tiempo se tarda? = How long does it take?
• ¿Puede ayudarme? = Can you help me?
• ¿Va por aquí? = Is it this way?

🔹 TO GIVE DIRECTIONS (to give directions):

MOVEMENT:
• sigue recto = go straight
• gira a la izquierda = turn left
• gira a la derecha = turn right
• cruza la calle = cross the street
• toma la primera calle = take the first street
• toma la segunda calle = take the second street
• continúa = continue

LOCATION OF THE DESTINATION:
• está a la izquierda = it's on the left
• está a la derecha = it's on the right
• está al final de la calle = it's at the end of the street
• está en la esquina = it's on the corner
• está a la vuelta de la esquina = it's around the corner
• está a dos cuadras = it's two blocks away

DISTANCE:
• está a cinco minutos a pie = it's a five-minute walk
• está a diez minutos en coche = it's a ten-minute drive
• está muy cerca = it's very close
• está bastante lejos = it's quite far

📌 EXAMPLES:
• Sigue recto y gira a la izquierda.
• Está al final de la calle.
• Toma la segunda calle a la derecha.
ejemplos: Sigue recto y gira a la izquierda.
Está al final de la calle.
Está a cinco minutos a pie.

t1.descripcion:
Prepositions of place to describe where things are:

🔹 BASIC POSITION:
• en = in / on / at (en la caja, en la mesa, en el cine)
• sobre / encima de = on top of (sobre la mesa, encima del armario)
• debajo de = under (debajo de la silla, debajo de la cama)

🔹 RELATIVE POSITION:
• delante de = in front of (delante de la puerta, delante de mí)
• detrás de = behind (detrás del sofá, detrás de la casa)
• al lado de = next to (al lado de la ventana, al lado del parque)
• cerca de = near (cerca de la escuela, cerca del centro)
• lejos de = far from (lejos de aquí, lejos del trabajo)

🔹 FRONTAL POSITION:
• enfrente de = opposite (enfrente del banco, enfrente de la iglesia)
• frente a = facing / opposite (frente a la plaza)

🔹 INTERNAL/EXTERNAL POSITION:
• dentro de = inside (dentro del armario, dentro de la caja)
• fuera de = outside (fuera de la casa, fuera de la ciudad)

🔹 POSITION BETWEEN:
• entre = between (entre la cama y la ventana, entre tú y yo)

🔹 POSITION AROUND:
• alrededor de = around (alrededor de la plaza, alrededor del parque)

📌 EXAMPLES:
• El libro está sobre la mesa.
• El gato está debajo de la silla.
• Vivo cerca del parque.
• El cine está al lado del centro comercial.
• La farmacia está enfrente del banco.
ejemplos: El libro está sobre la mesa.
El gato está debajo de la silla.
El supermercado está al lado del banco.

t2.descripcion:
Adverbs of place to indicate position without a reference object:

🔹 CLOSE DISTANCE:
• aquí / acá = here (aquí = exact location, acá = more general)
• ahí = there (near the person you're speaking to)
• allí / allá = there (far from both speaker and listener)

🔹 VERTICAL POSITION:
• arriba = up / upstairs (está arriba, vive arriba)
• abajo = down / downstairs (está abajo, el baño está abajo)
• en la planta de arriba = on the upper floor
• en la planta de abajo = on the lower floor

🔹 INTERNAL/EXTERNAL POSITION:
• dentro = inside (está dentro, entra dentro)
• afuera = outside (está afuera, espera afuera)

🔹 OTHER POSITIONS:
• alrededor = around (mira alrededor, hay gente alrededor)
• enfrente = opposite (vive enfrente, el banco está enfrente)
• detrás = behind (se escondió detrás)
• delante = in front (él va delante)
• cerca = close / near (está cerca, vive cerca)
• lejos = far (está lejos, la playa está lejos)

📌 EXAMPLES:
• Ven aquí, por favor.
• Allí está tu casa.
• El baño está arriba.
• La cocina está abajo.
• Deja las llaves ahí.
• No me gusta vivir tan lejos.

❌ COMMON MISTAKE:
Don't confuse "aquí" (aquí mismo) with "acá" (hacia aquí, más general). Also "allí" and "allá" have subtle differences.

dict.我住在一个小而安静的街区。我家靠近公园。我家前面有一家面包店。面包店旁边是药店。: I live in a small, quiet neighborhood. My house is near the park. In front of my house there is a bakery. Next to the bakery is a pharmacy. Behind the pharmacy there is a supermarket. Opposite the supermarket there is a school. Between the school and the park is the library. The library is far from the city center, but close to my house. To go downtown, I leave my house and go straight along the street. At the corner, turn right. The bus stop is there, opposite a square. Inside the square there is a fountain. Around the fountain there are many trees. My favorite place is the library. There are many books and it is always quiet.
dict.文中说“Delante de mi casa hay una panadería: The text says “Delante de mi casa hay una panadería.”, so the bakery is in front of my house.
dict.学校和公园之间有什么？: What is between the school and the park?
dict.文中说“Entre el colegio y el parque está la: The text says “Entre el colegio y el parque está la biblioteca.”, so it is the library.
dict.文中说“voy recto por la calle. En la esquin: The text says “voy recto por la calle. En la esquina giro a la derecha.”, so go straight and then turn right.
dict.文中说“La parada del autobús está allí, enf: The text says “La parada del autobús está allí, enfrente de una plaza.”, so it is opposite a square.
dict.在西班牙，广场是社会生活的中心。许多城市的马约尔广场很有名。广场周围有酒吧、商店: In Spain, the plaza is the center of social life. The Plaza Mayor in many cities is famous. Around the plaza there are bars, shops, and restaurants. In the center of the plaza there is sometimes a fountain or a monument. People meet there, chat, drink, or celebrate festivals. In summer, the outdoor seats are full. In winter there are also cultural events. The plaza is close to important buildings, such as the city hall or the church. If you visit a Spanish city, look for the main square: there is always something interesting there.
dict.在中国，广场也很常见，但通常更大，比如天安门广场，而且更多用于集体活动；西班牙的: In China, plazas are also common, but usually larger, like Tiananmen Square, and more used for collective activities; Spanish plazas are generally smaller, surrounded by cafes and shops, and more focused on daily socializing.
dict.汉语“在桌子上”可能说成“en la mesa encima”，但西班牙语用“s: In Chinese, “on the table” might be said as “en la mesa encima”, but Spanish uses “sobre” for “on top of”, and “encima” is not needed.
dict.本身表示“在……附近”，前面不加“en”。: It means “near” by itself, and “en” is not added before it.
dict.必须加“de”，不能省略。: “de” must be added and cannot be omitted.
dict.表示方向时，说“a la derecha”或“a la izquierda”，需: When indicating direction, say “a la derecha” or “a la izquierda”, and the definite article “la” is needed.
dict.这句话是正确的，但学生常误加“de”：不能说“entre de la tiend: This sentence is correct, but students often mistakenly add “de”: you cannot say “entre de la tienda”.
dict.超市在银行对面。: The supermarket is opposite the bank.
dict.我家在药店旁边。: My house is next to the pharmacy.
dict.广场中央有一个喷泉。: There is a fountain in the center of the plaza.
dict.公园离市中心很远。: The park is far from the city center.
dict.汉语中没有颤音，中国学生常把“r”发成汉语的“日”或“l”。练习时，舌尖轻轻抵住: Chinese has no trill, so Chinese students often pronounce “r” as the Chinese “r” or “l”. When practicing, lightly touch the tip of the tongue to the upper alveolar ridge and let the airflow make the tongue tip vibrate. The “r” at the beginning of a word should be trilled, as in “recto”; “rr” is also trilled, as in “arriba”.
dict.表示“在……上面”，符合句意。: It means “on top of”, which fits the sentence.

dict.狗在桌子下面。: The dog is under the table.
dict.图书馆在公园附近，2分钟路程。: The library is near the park, a 2-minute walk.
dict.是“向右”，根据常识，右转常用“a la derecha”。: It means “to the right”; based on common sense, “turn right” is usually “a la derecha”.
dict.广场周围有树。: There are trees around the plaza.

dict.问地点用“¿Dónde?”。: Use “¿Dónde?” to ask about a place.

dict.描述你的街区或城市：说出你家在哪里，附近有什么，以及如何到达一个重要地点。至少使: Describe your neighborhood or city: say where your house is, what is nearby, and how to get to an important place. Use at least five different prepositions of place.
dict.李伟和梅在街上。他们在找一家咖啡馆。: Li Wei and Mei are on the street. They are looking for a cafe.
dict.咖啡馆在哪里？就在这附近，对吧？: Where is the cafe? It's near here, right?
dict.是的，它在药店旁边，在银行和面包店之间。: Yes, it's next to the pharmacy, between the bank and the bakery.
dict.啊，看，那里有一家药店，在公园对面。: Ah, look, there's a pharmacy there, opposite the park.
dict.但是咖啡馆不在药店前面。它在后面。: But the cafe is not in front of the pharmacy. It's behind it.
dict.在后面？那我们得直走，然后在拐角处右转。: Behind? Then we have to go straight and turn right at the corner.
dict.是的，然后走一个街区。咖啡馆在左边，在购物中心里面。: Yes, then go one block. The cafe is on the left, inside the shopping center.
dict.真混乱！离这里远吗？: How confusing! Is it far from here?
dict.不远，很近。只要五分钟。看，咖啡馆在那里，在广场上面。: Not far, very close. Only five minutes. Look, the cafe is there, above the plaza.
dict.啊！它在购物中心外面，对吧？: Ah! It's outside the shopping center, right?
dict.不，在里面。但是外面有一个露台，在咖啡馆周围。: No, inside. But there is a terrace outside, around the cafe.
dict.太好了。那么，咖啡馆是在下面还是上面？: Great. So, is the cafe downstairs or upstairs?
dict.在下面，在一楼。走吧，我饿了！: Downstairs, on the first floor. Let's go, I'm hungry!
dict.从拐角处怎么去咖啡馆？: How do you get to the cafe from the corner?
dict.咖啡馆在购物中心里面的哪里？: Where is the cafe inside the shopping center?
dict.要找地方，用介词：在...旁边、在...之间、在...后面等。: To find a place, use prepositions: next to, between, behind, etc.
